title: Pumpkin Velouté
desc: Time-worn, red-painted wood anchors the quiet warmth of a rustic stone atelier. Bathed in soft, directional daylight from a nearby window, a hand-crafted ceramic bowl cradles a vibrant pumpkin velouté. Earthy shavings of black truffle and roasted seeds rest delicately on the velvety orange surface, gleaming within the deep, moody shadows.
